title: Synthetic ConsumerAgent Population Schema
description: Schema mapping HCES 2023-24 household records to the synthetic ConsumerAgent population

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for the synthetic agent (UUID or deterministic hash)

hces_household_key.description: The original FSU+Stratum+HH key from HCES for provenance

state.description: State or Union Territory (DIRECT HCES OBSERVATION)

household_size.description: Number of household members (DIRECT HCES OBSERVATION)

dwelling_type.description: Type of Dwelling Unit structure code (DIRECT HCES OBSERVATION). Strictly architectural, NOT tenure.

electricity_access.description: Primary energy source for lighting (DIRECT HCES OBSERVATION)

free_electricity_indicator.description: Indicates receipt of free electricity (DIRECT HCES OBSERVATION)

monthly_consumption_expenditure.description: Total monthly consumption expenditure for the household (DIRECT HCES OBSERVATION)

derived_mpce.description: Derived Monthly Per Capita Consumption Expenditure (DERIVED from MCE / HH Size)

mpce_decile.description: National economic decile computed via survey-weighted quantiles (DERIVED)

survey_weight.description: Original HCES Multiplier used for sampling probability (DIRECT HCES OBSERVATION)

system_size_distribution_kw.description: Placeholder for system size capacity. Set to null/UNAVAILABLE (Phase 4D.7)
